name: The Oracle Tree
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, adventurer. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
narrative.objectives: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.
narrative.offerRewardText: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 11 to 17, 3,120 XP in all.

quests.name: The Enchanted Glade
quests.objectiveText: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

quests.name: Darkness in the Glade
quests.objectiveText: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

quests.name: The Oracle Tree
quests.objectiveText: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.

quests.name: Teldrassil
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Inscribed Bark to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Grove of the Ancients
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.
